value="<h1>Transactions&nbsp;</h1><p><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 230, 204);">Funding transaction. Keys / Signature for spending come from the wallet crate. The signatures for all other transaction are made by the protocol crate, except for the CustomPayoutTx.</span></p><p><span style="background-color: rgb(213, 232, 212);">Only the DepositTx is broadcasted at the time of creation, the transactions right of it will have the problem that the necessary fee rate is not known for the time they are broadcasted.</span></p><p></p><p></p><p><span style="background-color: rgb(225, 213, 231);">These transaction are presigned with MuSig2. They are created and signed when the trade starts (before the DepositTx is signed and broadcast). They need to be signed at the time when both traders are online.</span></p><p><span style="background-color: rgb(176, 227, 230);">CustomPayoutTx and PenaltyTx are transaction signed on demand. The CustomPayoutTx is created when the traders agree on a payout, both wallets sign it with the script keys U and V. The PenaltyTx is signed by one trader alone, after the key exchange.</span></p>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="300" width="560" x="30" y="540" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="64" parent="1" style="swimlane;fontStyle=0;childLayout=stackLayout;horizontal=1;startSize=30;horizontalStack=0;resizeParent=1;resizeParentMax=0;resizeLast=0;collapsible=1;marginBottom=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;labelBackgroundColor=none;fillColor=#b0e3e6;strokeColor=#0e8088;" value="PenaltyTx<br>Bob / Alice" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="215" width="260" x="1380" y="-170" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="65" parent="64" style="text;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacingLeft=4;spacingRight=4;overflow=hidden;points=[[0,0.5],[1,0.5]];portConstraint=eastwest;rotatable=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;labelBackgroundColor=none;" value="prepared by the protocol together with the presigned transactions, but signed only when needed, by Bob / Alice alone with the private key p' / q'. It disincentivises the use of the WarningTx, when Bob / Alice has the key already." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="115" width="260" y="30" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="66" parent="64" P' = MuSig2 aggregate of the key shares Pa and Pb (p_tik), Q' = aggregate of Qa and Qb (q_tik)
an output with key spend P' or Q' is locked by that key, tweaked with its script spend 0 (if any)
U and V are script keys from the wallets of Alice and Bob
change outputs, funding from multiple inputs and trade fee outputs are not shown

p.span: Funding transaction. Keys / Signature for spending come from the wallet crate. The signatures for all other transaction are made by the protocol crate, except for the CustomPayoutTx.
Only the DepositTx is broadcasted at the time of creation, the transactions right of it will have the problem that the necessary fee rate is not known for the time they are broadcasted.

These transaction are presigned with MuSig2. They are created and signed when the trade starts (before the DepositTx is signed and broadcast). They need to be signed at the time when both traders are online.

CustomPayoutTx and PenaltyTx are transaction signed on demand. The CustomPayoutTx is created when the traders agree on a payout, both wallets sign it with the script keys U and V. The PenaltyTx is signed by one trader alone, after the key exchange.

div.p: nSequence of the inputs, see NetworkParams in transaction.rs:

warning lock time (WarningTx): 1440 blocks (10 days), regtest 5 blocks
claim lock time (ClaimTx): 720 blocks (5 days), regtest 5 blocks
RedirectTx, SwapTx, PenaltyTx and CustomPayoutTx: none
fee rate x fixed weight of the signed transaction: WarningTx 846 wu, SwapTx / ClaimTx / PenaltyTx 444 wu, CustomPayoutTx 1182 wu. The RedirectTx pays what the receivers and the anchor leave over.
